title: pouteria obovata
intro: Pouteria obovata, commonly known as the Sabal palm or Pouteria, is a type of plant species in the family Sapotaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria obovata include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
